versions.content: Using the hierarchical structuring of McDataInstance . subElement s The structure of the subElement s shall follow the structure of the cor- responding ApplicationDataType respectively ImplementationDataType . The value of the symbol attribute of the subElement s shall exist and it shall reflect the symbol of the subElement only (as opposed to reflecting the full combined symbol starting from the root element).
